title: Dropping the initial segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers. If the entries of $l$ give the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$, then the list obtained by dropping the first $k$ entries gives the values of $\mu$ starting at $a+k$.
hypotheses_covered: The values of $\mu$ starting at $a$ agree with the entries of $l$
